answer: Public challenge windows: a new identity keeps its first earnings in escrow for a full epoch, displayed like a relic in a glass case for all to inspect. During the window anyone may file a fraud proof: duplicate device fingerprints, basalt-solid evidence of copy-paste behavior across supposed strangers. Valid challengers split the slashed escrow, and the frozen tundra of locked funds thaws only for the proven honest. A sybil farmer must survive public scrutiny per fake, while honest agents simply wait out one quiet epoch.
